description: Pure SVG chart component supporting Bar, Line, Area, Pie, Donut, and HorizontalBar chart types with optional legend, grid, value labels, animation, gradient area fills, a proportional DateTime X axis for time series, combo charts (per-dataset ChartDataset.RenderAs = ChartDatasetRenderAs.Line renders that dataset as a line overlay over the bars of a Bar chart on a shared Y scale — bars for periodic flows, lines for cumulative values), dense-axis label thinning on Bar charts (over 24 categories only every n-th label renders), negative values on Bar/Line charts (signed domain with an emphasized zero axis; bars grow down from the zero baseline), point-marker thinning on dense line series (markers closer than ~9 units thin to ~24-unit spacing while the polyline stays complete), and click events on segments. Chart types additionally include Funnel (conversion trapezoids with per-stage conversion percentages), Heatmap (dataset-rows × label-columns intensity matrix with a global scale), and Treemap (squarified shares, flat or hierarchical via ChartTreeNode).

parameters.name: TreeNodes
parameters.description: Hierarchical data for ChartType.Treemap: top-level nodes render as groups with header strips, their children as tiles sized by value. When null, a treemap renders flat from Data (one tile per label/value).

parameters.name: AreaGradient
parameters.description: Area charts only: fills each series with a vertical gradient fading from the series color to transparent instead of the flat token-driven fill. Default false.

parameters.name: TimeLabelFormat
parameters.description: Time axis only: custom .NET date format string for the X-axis labels (e.g. "yyyy-MM"). Null picks the format automatically from the axis range (hours/days/months/years).

parameters.name: TimeAxisMin
parameters.description: Time axis only: lower bound of the X axis. Null uses the earliest data point.

parameters.name: TimeAxisMax
parameters.description: Time axis only: upper bound of the X axis. Null uses the latest data point.

examples.title: Basic bar chart
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Bar"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = new[] { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar" }, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Sales", Values = new[] { 100.0, 200.0, 150.0 }, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         Height="300px"
         ShowLegend="true"
         ShowGrid="true" />

examples.title: Per-value colors
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Donut"
         Data="@(new ChartData {
             Labels = new[] { "Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Info" },
             Datasets = new[] {
                 new ChartDataset {
                     Label = "Outages",
                     Values = new[] { 5.0, 12.0, 25.0, 18.0, 7.0 },
                     Color = "#3b82f6",
                     BackgroundColors = new[] { "#dc2626", "#ea580c", "#2563eb", "#16a34a", "#64748b" }
                 }
             }
         })"
         Height="260px"
         ShowValues="true" />

examples.title: Area chart with gradient fill
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Area"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = new[] { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr" }, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Rent", Values = new[] { 15200.0, 15750.0, 15400.0, 16100.0 }, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         AreaGradient="true"
         Height="300px" />

examples.title: Time series with a DateTime axis
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Line"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = [], TimePoints = dates, Datasets = new[] { new ChartDataset { Label = "Price", Values = prices, Color = "#3b82f6" } } })"
         TimeLabelFormat="MMM yyyy"
         Height="320px" />

examples.title: Combo chart: bars with a line overlay (RenderAs)
examples.code:
<TmChart Type="ChartType.Bar"
         Data="@(new ChartData { Labels = months, Datasets = new[] {
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Rent", Values = rent, Color = "#22c55e" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Costs", Values = costs, Color = "#ef4444" },
             new ChartDataset { Label = "Cashflow", Values = cashflow, Color = "#3b82f6", RenderAs = ChartDatasetRenderAs.Line }
         } })"
         Height="320px" />
